question: Which country is the Belgium Jupiler League from?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "league_with_country" AS SELECT CAST(t1.id AS BIGINT) AS league_id, t1.ls AS league_label, t2.value AS country_name FROM table_1 AS t1 INNER JOIN table_2 AS t2 ON CAST(t1.id AS BIGINT) = t2.id WHERE t2.attribute = 'name'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "league_with_country" AS SELECT CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(t1.id, '"', '')) AS BIGINT) AS league_id, t1.ls AS league_label, t2.value AS country_name FROM table_1 AS t1 INNER JOIN table_2 AS t2 ON CAST(TRIM(REPLACE(t1.id, '"', '')) AS BIGINT) = t2.id WHERE t2.attribute = 'name'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  lc.country_name AS country
FROM league_with_country lc
WHERE lower(lc.league_label) LIKE '%belgium jupiler league%'
GROUP BY 1
LIMIT 1
